name: podcast
description: Summary, chapters, and transcript of a podcast episode, from its page URL or from search words. Transcribes the audio on this Mac.

verbs.name: get
verbs.description: Digest of one episode, with the path of its saved transcript inside. Makes one paid model call unless the digest is cached.

input.description: Episode page or audio URL on any site yt-dlp supports, such as Apple Podcasts or SoundCloud.

verbs.name: transcript
verbs.description: Transcript of one episode. Makes no model call.

input.description: Episode page or audio URL on any site yt-dlp supports, such as Apple Podcasts or SoundCloud.

verbs.name: search
verbs.description: Digests of the episodes that search words find, plus the episodes that failed. Makes one paid model call per episode unless its digest is cached.

limit.description: How many search results to take, 1 by default.

site.description: yt-dlp search prefix, ytsearch by default, or scsearch for SoundCloud.
